quote: All customer data will be processed exclusively within the European Economic Area (EEA). Globex will not transfer customer data outside the EEA without the customer's prior written consent.
policy_quote: EU customer data must remain in the EU. Any clause permitting vendor to process EU customer data outside the EU is a violation. Violation: silence on data residency, or any clause allowing US/APAC processing of EU data.
reason: Processing is limited to the EEA, which meets 'EU customer data must remain in the EU' and the acceptable formulation of EU/EEA only. No US or APAC processing is permitted.
